title: Normalize Lowpoly Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize the lowpoly plugin crate (lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs) to the repo-wide Consistency Contract: adopt SDK PanelKit (tree_item_with_action/PanelTreeBuilder/UiTreeItemNode struct-literal) in place of local tree_item helper; adopt SDK Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) in place of hand-rolled LowpolyLabels struct + AppLabelsOverlay struct literal; adopt SDK Testkit (testkit::meta/new_app/assert_two_instances_converge/assert_ingest_idempotent) in place of local meta()/new_app()/MemoryBackbone::pair test scaffolding; verify C1 app-struct naming, C2/C3 region naming+order, C4 layout (single-app crate stays flat), C6 no app-to-app deps. Part of the GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES wave.
summary:
Normalized lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract.

C1 (naming): already compliant — app id "lowpoly-play" -> struct "LowpolyPlayApp" already matched; no rename needed.

C2/C3 (regions): "🔖️Manifest" and "🧪️Tests" region names were already correct. Fixed ordering: promoted "🔖️CommandLabels" and "🔖️TransformHelpers" out of the nested LowpolyPlayApp region to top-level regions (matching the canonical shooting/flow/imperative/vcs/animate pattern), giving final order Constants -> Runtime -> MeshTransfer -> SelectionHelpers -> TransformHelpers -> Scene -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Utilities -> LowpolyPlayApp -> Manifest -> Tests.

C4 (layout): single-app crate (only one "impl DocumentApp for" struct) — stays flat, no wrapping mod. Verified, no change needed.

C5/SDK adoption:
- PanelKit: deleted the local 10-arg `tree_item(...)` helper. Rewrote build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree/build_layers_tree on PanelTreeBuilder for the section/tree skeleton, `tree_item_with_action` for simple action items, and direct `UiTreeItemNode { .., ..UiTreeItemNode::base(id, label) }` struct-update construction for the richer document-tree items (hover_action/unhover_action/actions/items/default_open) — same idiom already used by process3d-plugin.
- Terminology: replaced the hand-rolled `struct LowpolyLabels` + `LOWPOLY_LABELS_NATIVE_EN`/`_DE` consts + `lowpoly_labels(view_state)` resolver with `semio_framework_plugin::app_labels!{ struct LowpolyLabels {...} }` + `resolve_labels::<LowpolyLabels>(view_state)` at all 4 call sites; `LOWPOLY_LABELS_NATIVE_EN`/`_DE` references (create_lowpoly_app + 2 tests) became `LowpolyLabels::EN`/`LowpolyLabels::DE` (the macro's inherent consts). `lowpoly_action_labels`/`lowpoly_utility_labels` now build on `localized_label_map(is_de, ENTRIES)` instead of a hand-rolled iterator/collect. `app_labels()` now returns `AppLabelsOverlay::default().window_kind_label(...)....` via `AppLabelsOverlayExt` instead of a full struct literal.
- Testkit: removed the local `meta()`/`ActionMeta` construction and `VcsDocumentApp::new(...)` wrapper in favor of `testkit::meta`/`testkit::new_app::<LowpolyPlayApp>()`; rewrote `two_instances_converge_disjoint_edits_via_backbone` and `ingest_operations_is_idempotent` on `testkit::assert_two_instances_converge`/`testkit::assert_ingest_idempotent` (probe = full `LowpolyProjection`, which already derives PartialEq+Debug), dropping the local `MemoryBackbone::pair`/`Backbone`/`BackboneMessage` scaffolding entirely. Kept the app-unique `projection()`/`face_selection()` test helpers and every other test body untouched (none of them were one of the 3 generic testkit shapes).

.resource_kind(...): already present (3d.lowpoly + 3d.mesh) from the earlier Wave-1 pass — verified, not touched.

C6: Cargo.toml deps are only semio-framework-plugin/semio-framework-os/vcs/lowpoly_core/kernel_3d_mesh — no app-to-app dependency. Verified, no change.

C7: no framework files touched.

Verification: brace/paren balance check passed (485/485, 2296/2296). Exhaustive grep cross-reference confirmed zero remaining references to every removed identifier (fn tree_item, lowpoly_labels(, LOWPOLY_LABELS_NATIVE_*, ActionMeta, MemoryBackbone, BackboneMessage, Backbone) and confirmed every new SDK identifier (PanelTreeBuilder, tree_item_with_action, UiTreeItemNode/Action, resolve_labels, localized_label_map, is_de_locale, AppLabelsOverlayExt, testkit::) is actually used. Manually re-read every touched region end-to-end for signature/type correctness against the real framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit source (not guessed). `cargo check -p lowpoly-plugin` was started but stayed on "Blocking waiting for file lock on build directory" for 3.5+ minutes (expected under current repo-wide concurrent-build contention per the verification policy) and was left running in the background rather than blocking the ticket — it did not reach a pass/fail verdict; the orchestrator's final full workspace check is the authoritative compile gate. `rustfmt --check` was not usable as a signal: the pre-existing file (see lib.rs.orig.backup in this ticket folder) already failed rustfmt --check with ~1118 diff lines before any of my edits (repo-wide hand-formatting diverges from stock rustfmt output under rustfmt.toml's max_width=250/use_small_heuristics=Max), so a fresh diff would be noise; instead I relied on the structural/reference checks above.

Nothing needed flagging as inexpressible in the current SDK — PanelKit's struct-update-over-UiTreeItemNode::base idiom covered every field the local tree_item helper exposed (icon/action/hover/unhover/actions/items/default_open/description), and AppLabelsOverlayExt covered every field this app's overlay used (window_kind/panel_tab/mode/action/utility/example labels).
